keyPoints.en: Freehand sketches: light construction lines first, then outlines, shading and annotation.
keyPoints.bm: Lakaran bebas: garisan binaan halus dahulu, kemudian garis luar, lorekan dan anotasi.

tip.en: Annotate every sketch: material, size, function.
tip.bm: Anotasi setiap lakaran: bahan, saiz, fungsi.

keyPoints.en: Isometric: vertical lines + lines at 30°; circles appear as ellipses.
keyPoints.bm: Isometrik: garisan menegak + garisan 30°; bulatan kelihatan sebagai elips.

keyPoints.en: Oblique: true front face, depth lines at 45°.
keyPoints.bm: Oblik: muka hadapan sebenar, garisan kedalaman 45°.

keyPoints.en: Lines: thick continuous (outline), thin dashed (hidden), thin chain (centre), thin with arrows (dimension).
keyPoints.bm: Garisan: tebal berterusan (garis luar), putus-putus nipis (tersembunyi), rantai nipis (tengah), nipis beranak panah (dimensi).

keyPoints.en: Scale 1:2 = half size; dimensions always show real sizes in mm.
keyPoints.bm: Skala 1:2 = separuh saiz; dimensi sentiasa menunjukkan saiz sebenar dalam mm.
